channel.title: Tozi Packaging: Custom Chocolate Boxes
channel.description: Custom Chocolate Boxes from Tozi Packaging

item.title: Empty Chocolate Boxes
item.description: Before the first truffle is placed, before the tissue is folded, before the ribbon is tied, the box is already making a promise. The depth of its cavities, the resistance of its lid, the surface quality under your fingertip, all of it tells the person who will eventually receive this gift exactly what kind of chocolatier made the decision to put their product inside it.

item.title: Gift Chocolate Boxes
item.description: A lid lifts to reveal a grid of chocolates sitting in precisely formed cavities, each piece held at the same angle, the same depth, the same deliberate distance from its neighbour, and the person holding the box already understands that what they are looking at was made with care. That recognition happens before a single chocolate is touched, and it is entirely created by the packaging.
